title: Emergency Support Trust Fund / Feasibility / Impacted Customers / Cover Portion of City Utility Services Bill / Accepting Donations
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council requests the City Attorney, in collaboration with the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power and the City Administrative Officer, to report on the feasibility of creating a trust fund for emergency support to impacted customers in covering portions of their city utility services bill. The funding of the trust should not be incurred by the ratepayer, but should be an available vehicle to accept private donations and contributions from philanthropic partnerships, and other funding sources separate from ratepayers. PRESENTED BY X________ YSABEL JURADO zamwar Councilmember, 14th District SECONDED BY sg222026.

departments: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power
requests.asks: Report on the feasibility of creating a trust fund that helps impacted customers cover portions of their city utility services bill, funded by private donations, philanthropic partnerships and other sources separate from ratepayers.
